$comment: Share images and social posts, from the agd-playground posts tool (src/components/conare-og: draw.ts, layouts.ts, brand.ts, content.ts, app.ts; route /conare and its PNG endpoint /conare/og). The layout rules are the engine's (src/assets/layouts.ts and og.ts); this file holds the brand's part: themes as token names (an alpha after a slash), the frame tones, highlight colors, the address, the art files, the agent panel's colors, each template's opening theme and badge style, sample copy (drawn only with --sample), and the sizes with the platform's safe areas. Nothing is drawn that was not asked for, except the logo and the address. Every playground hex matched a token except the ones in notes.

panel.$comment: The dark agent window (app.ts), drawn on a 1040 by 640 grid. It is drawn without words (the copy is bars) unless --sample asks for the sample content, which replaces the playground's third-party product names (Granola, Salesforce, Gmail, Attio) and the Northwind account with neutral ones.

sizes.$comment: The shared sizes (src/design/platforms.ts: pixels, what each platform covers, upload limits). Here: the frame the layouts keep to in a size with covered parts, and where the logo may be anchored (safe).

notes: Every playground brand color (brand.ts INK) is a token: white off-white, black off-black, red home-red, paper home-paper, grey home-grey, n100 to n700 neutral-100 to neutral-700.

Agent panel: the playground's #1f1e1d ground is neutral-100 (#201F1E); its rules #3a3937 and chips #2c2b2a have no token and draw in neutral-200 (#31302F); the field chip edge #4a4846 is neutral-300 (#494745).
Product window ground: the playground's #ffffff is off-white (#FEFEFE); the empty window's #f4f2f7 is home-paper.

The card's chip and the footer use Geist Mono at 500 in the playground; the brand ships Geist Mono 400 only, so they draw at 400. The partner name draws at 600 in Faculty Glyphic, which ships at 400 only.

Left out: the playground's product scenes (public/conare-og/screens/*.jpg) show third-party logos (Granola, Salesforce, Gmail, Attio) and photos of people. The feature window takes your picture with --image; without one it draws a stand-in scene from the brand's own parts (the room, the stacks and the agent panel).

Left out: partner logos (third-party art; pass the partner's name), the editor's free stickers and gradients (not templates), and random layout seeds (in the playground a seed only picks one of these templates).

Contrast: off-white on home-red is 4.17, under 4.5 for small text. Small label chips draw on home-red-hover (the nearest red that passes), and lines on the red theme draw at full off-white and no smaller than 24 px at a 1200 px canvas.
Contrast: the grey highlight (neutral-500, 2.9 on white) draws as neutral-400 on light themes. The line under a headline draws in the theme's muted token instead of the playground's faded ink.
The brand gives no logo clear space or minimum size. The engine keeps its own layout spacing (a quarter of the lockup's height) and a legible height, and claims neither as a brand rule.

The room's back wall is sized to the words and the window, so no line runs behind them (in the playground it was a fixed share of the image and lines crossed the words). The wordmark tile, the hollow wordmark and the partner pattern draw whole words only.
